title: Detailed laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Laptop base / bottom deck -->
  <rect x='10' y='62' width='80' height='24' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#7a8a9a'/>
  <!-- Base top surface highlight -->
  <rect x='12' y='62' width='76' height='4' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#9aaabb'/>
  <!-- Lid (open, angled back) -->
  <polygon points='10,62 12,20 88,20 90,62' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <!-- Screen bezel -->
  <polygon points='14,58 16,25 84,25 86,58' fill='#223344'/>
  <!-- Screen display -->
  <polygon points='18,55 19,29 81,29 82,55' fill='#1a5c9a'/>
  <!-- Screen content: code lines -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='30' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5ec8e8'/>
  <rect x='24' y='40' width='44' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8de05a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='46' width='26' height='3' rx='1' fill='#f0c050'/>
  <rect x='28' y='52' width='38' height='3' rx='1' fill='#e87a9a'/>
  <!-- Screen shine -->
  <polygon points='18,55 19,29 34,29 28,55' fill='#2a7cc0' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- Keyboard area -->
  <rect x='20' y='67' width='60' height='14' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#5a6a7a'/>
  <!-- Keyboard keys on row 1 -->
  <rect x='23' y='68' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <rect x='31' y='68' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <rect x='39' y='68' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <rect x='47' y='68' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <rect x='55' y='68' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <rect x='63' y='68' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <rect x='71' y='68' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <!-- Keyboard keys on row 2 -->
  <rect x='23' y='74' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <rect x='31' y='74' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <rect x='39' y='74' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <rect x='47' y='74' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <rect x='55' y='74' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <rect x='63' y='74' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <rect x='71' y='74' width='8' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8899aa'/>
  <!-- Spacebar -->
  <rect x='31' y='74' width='28' height='4' rx='1' fill='#66788a'/>
  <!-- Trackpad -->
  <rect x='38' y='80' width='24' height='4' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#95a5b5'/>
  <!-- Hinge line -->
  <rect x='10' y='60' width='80' height='2' rx='1' fill='#aabbcc'/>
  <!-- Small indicator LED -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#5ee87a'/>
  <!-- Port on side -->
  <rect x='88' y='66' width='3' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <!-- Port details -->
  <rect x='89' y='67' width='1' height='2' fill='#7a8a9a'/>
</svg>
